title: A missing or unrecognised workflowShape field fails fast with a stable-coded error
asA: operator maintaining a project on delivery-ci-workflows v2
iWant: the workflow-materialiser to refuse to run when its input `workflowShape` is missing a required field or carries an unrecognised value
soThat: a misconfiguration is caught at boot with a message I can match on, not by a subtly wrong-shaped workflow set landing on disk

acceptanceCriteria.description: A `workflowShape` missing any of the three required fields (`branchModel`, `checkSet`, `providerHint`) causes the workflow-materialiser to exit non-zero with a stable error code and a message naming the missing field. `releaseMode` being absent does NOT fail the boot-check (per Q6-B ratification): the materialiser treats absent `releaseMode` as `releaseMode: none` and ships no release workflow. No workflow file is written when the boot-check does fail.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a `workflowShape` declaration whose `providerHint` field is absent (or any of the three required fields)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the materialiser exits non-zero, prints an error naming the missing field with a stable code, and leaves the provider's workflow directory unchanged
acceptanceCriteria.templateFillIns: The applying agent sets the workflowShape elicits (checkSet, branchModel, releaseMode, scheduledAudit, providerHint); the AC substitutes the project's declaration for the illustrative shape values.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A required field whose value is not in the recognised enumeration for that field causes the same failure shape: non-zero exit, stable-coded error, no workflow file written.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a `workflowShape` carrying `branchModel: hybrid` (a value the enumeration does not include)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the materialiser exits non-zero, prints an error naming the field, the value received, and the recognised set, with a stable code
acceptanceCriteria.templateFillIns: The applying agent sets the workflowShape elicits (checkSet, branchModel, releaseMode, scheduledAudit, providerHint); the AC substitutes the project's declaration for the illustrative shape values.

acceptanceCriteria.description: An absent .rcf/config/delivery-ci-workflows.json file is refused at materialise-time with a stable-coded WORKFLOW_CONFIG_MISSING naming the expected path; no workflow file is written to the workflow directory.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project tree that has never applied a workflow shape (no .rcf/config/delivery-ci-workflows.json)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the materialiser exits with a non-zero code and emits WORKFLOW_CONFIG_MISSING naming the expected path; the workflow directory is unchanged

acceptanceCriteria.description: An unparseable .rcf/config/delivery-ci-workflows.json (invalid JSON) is refused at materialise-time with a stable-coded WORKFLOW_CONFIG_UNPARSEABLE naming the file path and the parser error; no workflow file is written.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project tree with .rcf/config/delivery-ci-workflows.json containing invalid JSON (e.g. a trailing comma before EOF)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the materialiser exits with a non-zero code and emits WORKFLOW_CONFIG_UNPARSEABLE naming the file path and the parser error position; the workflow directory is unchanged
